description: Productivity norms used by the engine to derive activity durations from quantities. Managed in admin alongside the fragnet library (ADMIN_SPEC.md section 2).
provenance_summary: INDUSTRY ESTIMATES, NOT PROJECT ACTUALS. Typical output rates for Indian construction, in the right range and argued for per entry, but not drawn from any rate analysis or from a delivered project's actuals. Durations computed from these norms will look precise and are not evidence. DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 1 is explicit that real execution records and actuals are what make the output expert - replace these with the client's own data.
